title: Stop wasting Claude tokens: Handy
summary: When Claude analyses a video, photo or audio file, it downloads it, goes online or watches it frame by frame, and all that reading and writing eats a lot of tokens. Handy is an open-source, super-fast transcription tool: press the shortcut, talk, and it types. I'm connecting it to Claude so Claude can transcribe through it. Results are coming in a later reel.
steps: Install Handy from its official GitHub page.
Press the shortcut (in the reel: Ctrl + Shift) and talk. Handy types what you say.
Use it to dictate long prompts to Claude instead of typing.
For audio and video, transcribe locally first and give Claude the text, not the file.
Use the prompt below to have Claude set up a local transcription workflow, with your approval for every install.

prompts.title: Transcribe locally to save tokens
prompts.text:
I want to stop uploading audio and video files to you for analysis because it uses a lot of tokens. Help me transcribe them locally on my PC instead, and then I'll give you only the text.

My PC: [WINDOWS / MAC], [GPU IF ANY].
I already have: [HANDY / NOTHING YET].
File to test with: [FILE PATH].

1. Check what's already installed that can do offline speech-to-text (for example Handy and its model, or ffmpeg for extracting audio).
2. Suggest the simplest local setup. Ask me before installing anything.
3. Transcribe the test file to a text file next to it: [OUTPUT FOLDER].
4. Tell me how to repeat this myself next time in 2 or 3 steps.

Everything stays on my computer. Don't upload the file anywhere.

prompts.title: Work from my transcript, not the video
prompts.text:
Here is the transcript of my video, made locally: [PASTE TRANSCRIPT].

Work only from this text. Don't ask me to upload the video.
[YOUR TASK, e.g. write captions / find the best 30-second clip / list the key points / write a title and description].

notes: The Claude + Handy connection was still being built in this reel. Results not shown yet.
Local transcription keeps your files on your computer.
Check Handy's settings for your own shortcut.
